registration_timing: POST_HOC — this round ran WITHOUT a frozen pre-registration. This file is written AFTER execution and is explicitly NOT a pre-registration. It exists so later rounds can see exactly which claims were committed in advance (none) and which were decided while looking at the data (everything below).
why_no_prereg: PPC-MOUSE-01 was specified as an exploratory feasibility round (P0-P4) whose deliverable is 'can M0 be built on the shared core, and what is missing'. Freezing numeric gates before knowing whether the search even runs at a mouse root would have produced a gate that measures nothing. The cost of that choice is stated here: no threshold in this round carries pre-registered authority.

claims_made.claim: The existing Stepwise Expectiminimax is correct at a MOUSE root: MIN for the mouse, MAX for the cat, real-probability CHANCE, unchanged mate-distance and TT EXACT semantics.
claims_made.measurement: 14 root-depth pairs (11 fixtures at D1 + M_MICRO/M_BUTTER_MICRO/M_CAT_MATE3 at D2) vs an unpruned, TT-free, ordering-free, budget-free oracle
claims_made.scope_limit: The oracle shares simulateSearchAction / mateActionCost / stepChildForParent / evaluateForCat with production. This proves the SEARCH COMBINATORICS, not the transition rules. Rule correctness is only covered by real-engine execution (C4).

claims_made.claim: No new Expectiminimax was written. Every M0 decision goes through the production searchBestActionIterative.

The wrong hypothesis (bound/window contamination) was eliminated with readings before the real cause was found: tt=false ab=false ord=false ALSO returned 135.000.
